searched: The files: every vendored library (vendor/*/LICENSE.txt, each npm release sha512-checked) and every asset folder (assets/quaternius from the packs' own License.txt, assets/polypizza from each model's Poly Pizza page). The web: each asset's page read 7 Nov 2026; the title "Painted Ronin" searched for an existing game of that name. The kasa, the katana, the scabbard, the rocks, the banners, the leaves and every sound are made in code here. 8 Nov 2026: the painted look's sources read at source (research H and I in the receipts): mypaint/mypaint-brushes' Licenses.dep5 (brushes/* CC0-1.0), libmypaint's COPYING (ISC), stegu/webgl-noise's LICENSE (MIT).
mine: The game: its code (src/), its land, its rules, its look (the painterly pass is ported from Maxime Heckel's MIT code, credited in src/painterly.js; the painted sky, clouds, birds and strokes are written here to published methods — Sea of Thieves' cloud talk, Valve's TF2 shading paper, Meier's painterly rendering, the ukiyo-e bokashi — credited in each file), the kasa, katana, scabbard, rocks and banners, its sounds (ZzFX numbers, Karplus-Strong koto) and its name, made for this game with Claude Code and proven-stack.
